title: Air Strike on Calarcá Dissidents' Frente 33 Camp in Catatumbo
detail: President de la Espriella announced a pre-dawn bombing by Kfir and Super Tucano aircraft on a Frente 33 (Calarcá faction) camp between Tibú and El Tarra, Norte de Santander, where 20+ fighters were reportedly present. It is the first such strike since a court halted bombings and the fourth under his administration; results were still to be reported.
